fields.name: context
fields.description: Inspected target and capability/environment snapshot; refreshed only by explicit commands.

fields.name: face_enabled

fields.name: face_mode

fields.name: identity

fields.name: committed
fields.description: True only after atomic publication; cannot transition to cancellation terminal afterward.

fields.name: error_text

fields.name: result_text

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: Current option highlight; UI navigation does not accept values.

invariants.expression: NOT authorized AND NOT committed => no config/temporary/directory writes
invariants.description: Reads and previews cannot create filesystem state.

invariants.expression: draft.face.random == true => draft.face.seed absent AND draft.face.preset absent; otherwise at most one of seed,preset
invariants.description: Three on-disk sources: preset, seed, random.

invariants.expression: face_mode == random-once => saved face.seed == sample_seed AND saved face.random absent
face_mode == random-each-run => saved face.random == true AND sample_seed is never serialized
invariants.description: Generate one ephemeral identity per future invocation.

invariants.expression: runtime random identity is resolved once and reused for all expression/frame renders in that invocation
invariants.description: No random change between frames or repeated face tokens.

invariants.expression: selected_modules has unique supported IDs; length >= 1 before leaving modules.ready
commit input bytes == review_data.toml AND input snapshot == context fingerprint
invariants.description: Any edit or refresh clears authorization.

invariants.expression: stdout contains only saved absolute path + newline after commit; all interaction and diagnostics use stderr
invariants.description: No JSON mode or piped input.
Signals after the publication boundary cannot promise no writes.

invariants.expression: review preparation does not change sample_seed
invariants.description: Every-run sample is stable until explicit reroll or identity change.

commands.side_effect: Read only: parse smol init [--config PATH] [--help], reject other options/positionals; help precedes TTY checks. Require stdin and stderr TTY. Resolve explicit path > XDG_CONFIG_HOME > HOME, reject absent destination. Lstat target and parent components; refuse symlinks/special files. Read bytes and mode, SHA-256 snapshot, parse with extended config schema. Malformed existing TOML becomes a visible replacement warning and disables Existing preset. Permission/read failures emit inspect.failed. No directories, lock files, temp files or config writes.
Build a static character using the current face preset/seed API and selected expression (idle initially). Pure computation; no persistence, animation or subprocesses.

Read 16 bytes from injected OS entropy, encode as 32 lowercase hex characters, build using that seed and emit sample plus seed. A reroll reads fresh bytes. No seed is printed in every-run mode or persisted until save. Entropy failure is explicit. No fallback to a fixed face.

Read-only validation and serialization of exact TOML; include random=true only in every-run mode, with seed/preset absent. Static system preview uses injected providers and the existing 20ms renderer budget; unavailable modules vanish with normal separator semantics. Every-run preview reuses session sample_seed: preparing review never rerolls. Return exact TOML bytes, sample and shell instructions; no config writes or subprocesses.

Only after explicit Yes: recheck target snapshot (existence, device/inode, SHA-256 bytes, mode), reject unsafe targets and drift. Create missing parents with 0700, same-directory exclusive temp file 0600, write exact reviewed bytes, preserve existing regular-file permissions, sync and close; recheck snapshot immediately before atomic rename. For absent destination use atomic no-replace publication; never clobber a newly created file. Cancel before commit deletes temp and newly created empty parents. Existing-file replacement uses atomic rename; external writes in the last check-to-rename interval cannot be excluded without cooperating writers. Block cancellation across the short publication critical section; successful publication always emits save.committed, even if a signal arrives then. No automatic retries. No backups or shell-file edits.

Read-only target inspection and fingerprint refresh, same safe-target rules as initial inspection. Retain draft; malformed changed file is a warning and replacement still needs explicit review and confirmation.

Write absolute saved path plus one newline to stdout. Write Saved confirmation and shell setup instructions to stderr, using the exact destination safely quoted. Output failure returns 1 and states that config WAS saved; never retry commit or remove a saved config.

Cancel workers, discard stale outcomes, remove uncommitted temp files and only newly created empty parents, restore input mode/cursor and finish the current stderr line. Never delete or alter a committed config. Completion is reported once cleanup is synchronous/awaited.

Cancel workers after SIGTERM, discard stale outcomes, remove uncommitted temp files and only newly created empty parents, restore input mode/cursor and finish the current stderr line. Never delete or alter a committed config. Completion is reported once cleanup is synchronous/awaited.

Read only: parse smol init [--config PATH] [--help], reject other options/positionals; help precedes TTY checks. Require stdin and stderr TTY. Resolve explicit path > XDG_CONFIG_HOME > HOME, reject absent destination. Lstat target and parent components; refuse symlinks/special files. Read bytes and mode, SHA-256 snapshot, parse with extended config schema. Malformed existing TOML becomes a visible replacement warning and disables Existing preset. Permission/read failures emit inspect.failed. No directories, lock files, temp files or config writes.
Generate a fresh random character sample; identical to face.roll but dispatched by the explicit Reroll action.

Read 16 bytes from injected OS entropy, encode as 32 lowercase hex characters, build using that seed and emit sample plus seed. A reroll reads fresh bytes. No seed is printed in every-run mode or persisted until save. Entropy failure is explicit. No fallback to a fixed face.
Build a static character using the current face preset/seed API and selected expression (idle initially). Pure computation; no persistence, animation or subprocesses.

Read-only validation and serialization of exact TOML; include random=true only in every-run mode, with seed/preset absent. Static system preview uses injected providers and the existing 20ms renderer budget; unavailable modules vanish with normal separator semantics. Every-run preview reuses session sample_seed: preparing review never rerolls. Return exact TOML bytes, sample and shell instructions; no config writes or subprocesses.
Regenerate validated TOML, fingerprint, preview and instructions after a conflict refresh; never rerolls the sample seed.

fields.name: toml

fields.name: sample

fields.name: instructions

fields.name: error

fields.name: HOME
